market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is just one of many potential Republican candidates for 2028, with no clear front‑runner status this far out. Historical markets rarely price a non‑incumbent above 10% 3+ years before an election, and at 14.2% the implied probability likely overstates his true chances. Incorporating the crowded likely field, the possibility of a Democratic win, and the long time horizon, I estimate a true probability near 6%.
evidence_points: 2028 is an open Republican primary with no incumbent; the field historically widens and odds for any single candidate are low.
Recent early-cycle markets for presidential winners have assigned most non‑incumbents probabilities well below 10% until a clear front‑runner emerges.
Rubio remains a known figure but lacks a dominant polling lead even among Republicans, and faces rivals like DeSantis, Haley, and others.
sources_consulted: Historical PredictIt and Metaculus long‑range presidential markets
